{{Quote|I'm old enough, I first came here, you could drive in across the wasteland. They had a groundcarry. Drive right through. That was no bargain either. You'd make the round trip and taste it a week later. Just nasty. Now it's this.|Willi|audio=Groundcarry-Willi-ThatWouldBeMe.flac|<ref name="Andor2" />}}
A '''groundcarry''' was a type of ground vehicle used to [[transport]] passengers. When the propulsion provider [[Willi]] first visited the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]],<ref name="Andor2" /> he<ref name="Andor2 AD">{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> traveled into<ref name="Andor2" /> [[Ferrix City]]<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|219|Galactic Britain II: Cassian's Travels}}</ref> by driving across the wastelands surrounding the [[city]] in a groundcarry. Using the service was expensive, and a round trip cost enough to leave a nasty taste in Willi's [[mouth]] a [[Standard week|week]] later.<ref name="Andor2" />

By [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|102}}</ref> the groundcarry had been replaced by [[HFY-3920 shuttle ferry|shuttle ferries]] as the means of reaching Ferrix City. While traveling on [[Engine 22|one]] such [[shuttle]]<ref name="Andor2" /> that [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date" /> Willi told his fellow passenger [[Luthen Rael]] about the groundcarry he had previously used and its cost.<ref name="Andor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
A groundcarry was mentioned in "[[That Would Be Me]],"<ref name="Andor2" /> the second episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].<ref name="Companion">{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}}</ref>
